name: unified-completion
scope: single query plan shared by route and orchestrator
single response finalization policy for streaming and non-streaming
single suggestion policy for persisted and transient responses
canonical governance_result persistence and reload contract
centralized pipeline and snapshot version constants
behavioral_change_summary: Official Gazette suggestions are suppressed consistently in every delivery path; all paths use the same finalization.
knownLimitations: Full end-to-end validation still requires configured Supabase and OpenAI credentials.
The structural validator does not replace browser verification of streaming replacement events.
